## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Evidence

List the tests, fixed baselines, or evaluations used to validate it.

## Research and safety checks

- [ ] Core behavior remains provider-neutral.
- [ ] Tests require no credentials, network access, Docker, or paid inference.
- [ ] No raw prompts, trajectories, patches, logs, secrets, or benchmark workspaces are committed.
- [ ] Empirical claims identify the model, harness, evaluator, price snapshot, and evidence status.
- [ ] Protocol or artifact changes include the required versioned amendment and updated lock.
